body:
The Breakthrough Bracelet is an exclusive Energy Muse formula piece designed by co-founder Heather Askinosie, created with the intention of helping you move through deep transformation with strength, clarity, and protection. Every detail—down to the number of stones, the specific crystals chosen, and the exact sequencing—was intentionally crafted by Heather to amplify energetic alignment and support the powerful shifts happening within you. This bracelet features five transformative stones and a center Copper bead, all working in harmony to help you break through limitations and step decisively into your next level.

At the foundation of this formula is Tibetan Agate, a stone revered for centuries for its protective and grounding properties. It stabilizes your energy field, clears energetic debris, and strengthens your connection to your inner truth. Pyrite, the stone of action and perseverance, fuels your motivation and determination, helping you stay committed to your goals and overcome obstacles with confidence.

Onyx supports the release of negative and self-defeating thoughts, giving you the courage to face fears and dissolve old patterns that no longer serve you. Phantom Quartz is a stone of growth and evolution, guiding you through periods of change while helping you tap into willpower, resilience, and higher perspective. Matte Black Sardonyx fills you with unwavering faith in yourself, encouraging you to step outside your comfort zone and trust the path ahead.

At the center of this energetic formula is Copper, a conductor of vitality and intention that amplifies the vibration of every stone in the bracelet. Together, these elements create a potent energetic tool for transformation, protection, and empowered forward movement.
